judge.evidence_requirement: Quote or reference specific worker findings, concern coverage, coordination records, completeness checks, and brief content for every score.

dimensions.description: Findings are supported by whole-ticket evidence and include complete confidence, impact, scope, fix-direction, Context-limit, and acceptance-evidence records.
Both lenses independently resolve guidance and account for coherent regions in the required Review level order.
Structural aggregation preserves conclusions, compatible grouping, disagreements, ordering, and coverage without second-review judgment.
The complete brief is inspectable, local, and read-only.

evals.name: complete ordinary Code Review outcome
evals.prompt: Review a nontrivial implementation with seeded domain and design defects. The complete Ticket outcome and immutable range are supplied. Return the local read-only Review brief and retained artifacts.
evals.expected_output: The treatment finds supported defects through independent lenses, retains clean negative regions, and returns a structurally complete Review brief. The matched fresh No-Skill arm receives the same scenario and run configuration.
expectations: Treatment and No-Skill runs use fresh matched sessions and differ only in Skill provisioning.
Every critical seeded finding is backed by cited whole-ticket evidence and every clean region remains covered.
Concern coverage stays separate from findings and can preserve disagreement between workers.
The coordinator records every source finding disposition without changing worker conclusions.
Mechanical checks validate exact artifact structure, immutable identities, required fields, package closure, and forbidden mutations only.
Blind evidence-bearing model judgment and sampled human review decide semantic finding validity and coverage.
Generated review runs, judge payloads, reports, and viewer output remain uncommitted.
